resources.string: Ask about cooking or your pantry…
Hi! Ask me what to cook with your food, how to use items that are expiring, or what to swap for a missing ingredient.
To answer, your message and a list of your pantry items (names, amounts and expiry dates) will be sent to an AI service. Nothing is sent if you cancel.
